name: seahorse-memory
description: Persistent, bi-temporal memory for LLM agents over stdio MCP: append-only episodes (valid_at/created_at), supersedes chains, procedural skills, and a session-context bootstrap — backed by an Obsidian-native vault the human reads and edits.

uvx.description: Run the stdio MCP server in an isolated uvx environment (no install).

python.description: Persistent install with the semantic-retrieval + LLM extras (then register with `seahorse setup --harness <ids>`).

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Persist a fact (episodic write, provenance object required).

tools.name: recall_timeline
tools.description: TIMELINE level for an anchor episode.

tools.name: improve
tools.description: Supersede a fact with a correction (history preserved).

tools.name: skill_show
tools.description: Show a skill's gated body (trust gate).

tools.name: context
tools.description: Bootstrap context for a new session (recent episodes + last session).
